description:
At the beginning of the end step prior to your turn, Form of the Dragon's second ability triggers, causing your life total to become five.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Form of the Dragon's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, causing you and an opponent to swap life totals.
Resolve the Form of the Dragon trigger, dealing five damage to the opponent who you swapped life totals with.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.
